fonts.decision: No font files ship yet. The theme names installed families through SystemFont: Inter, then Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, Arial for text; JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, Courier New for monospace.
fonts.follow_up: Add Inter and one OFL monospace (JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono) as files with their OFL texts and upstream versions, then point the theme at them

icons.decision: Icons are line shapes drawn by godot/src/widgets/glyph.gd on a 24-unit grid, written for this editor. No icon set or image file is copied.
